dataset: Nord Pool electricity market dataset with hourly electricity price and exogenous grid measurements spanning 6 years (2013-01-01 to 2018-12-24).

short.text: price: Day-ahead hourly electricity price in the Nord Pool market (EUR/MWh).
grid_load_forecast: Forecasted total grid load in MW, reflecting anticipated electricity demand across the Nord Pool system.
wind_power_forecast: Forecasted wind power generation in MW, capturing the expected renewable energy supply in the market.
